documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Considering Unaudited Financial Results For Quarter And Half-Year Ended 30Th September, 2026
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Somany Ceramics reported modest sales volume growth of about 3% in Q1 FY27 due to temporary supply constraints from Morbi, while value grew by 24%. EBITDA margins expanded by 3.6% to 11.6%, driven by higher capacity utilization in standalone plants and improved performance of joint ventures. Management remains optimistic about future demand, announced a major plant expansion in the South, and expects to maintain or improve current margin levels. Additionally, working capital days decreased significantly, and the company is undertaking balancing equipment additions to further augment capacity and product mix. Somany Ceramics reported a strong performance in Q1 FY27 with consolidated revenue growing 24% year-on-year to INR 744 crore, supported by improved realizations and a favourable product mix.

guidance.claim: Management maintains that the EBITDA margins delivered in the current quarter would be sustained and is trying to better them.
guidance.quote: And we maintain that the EBITDA margins delivered in this quarter would be maintained, and we are trying to better our EBITDA margins, which we have delivered in last quarter and on this quarter.

guidance.claim: The company expects mid-single-digit volume growth for the year.
Management targets to achieve 12% and more in EBITDA margins.
guidance.quote: Yes, absolutely. That's the target that we achieve 12% and more.

guidance.claim: Management guided to improve EBITDA margin by at least 1.5% or more from the current base.
guidance.quote: our guidance is to improve EBITDA margin from here by at least 1.5% or more.

guidance.claim: The company expects very healthy double-digit growth for the sanitaryware and adhesive business.
guidance.quote: For the sanitaryware and adhesive business would be in very healthy double digits.

demand_outlook.claim: Export from Morbi is down by 50% to 60% from the peak due to geopolitical reasons.
demand_outlook.quote: The only negative in the quarter has been from a Morbi perspective is exports has been down due to geopolitical reasons, the export is down a good 50%, 60% from the peak.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic about industry growth prospects supported by sustained demand from housing, infrastructure, and renovation segments.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, we remain optimistic about the industry’s growth prospects, supported by sustained demand from housing, infrastructure, and renovation segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic demand saw a gradual improvement during January and February.
demand_outlook.quote: as far as the quarter is concerned, the domestic demand saw a gradual improvement during January and Feb on account of increased domestic demand reducing the pressure on -- from reducing the pressure from exports.

demand_outlook.claim: March was an aberration month due to circumstances playing out geopolitically.
demand_outlook.quote: Obviously, March was a very aberration month because of the various circumstances which played out geopolitically.

demand_outlook.claim: Consumers take time to absorb a 15% to 17% price increase.
demand_outlook.quote: we had a price increase of approximately 15%, 17% and Morbi of 30%. So consumers take a while to absorb this kind of price increase.

capex_expansion.claim: The company announced setting up a 9-plus million square meter plant in the South with an outlay of approximately INR220 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Because of that, we have announced setting up a 9 million square meter plant -- 9-plus million square meter plant in the South, which would be up and ready by in the next 12 to 15 months. This would give us a potential revenue of about INR350 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is adding capacity by about 4 million to 5 million in existing lines across Bahadurgarh, Gujarat, Morbi, and the South.
capex_expansion.quote: Other than that, we are taking many more steps, which are all work in progress to augment further capacity by about 4 million to 5 million in our existing lines in Bahadurgarh in -- which is in Haryana and in Gujarat and in Morbi and also in the South.

capex_expansion.claim: The Company announced a new manufacturing facility to cater to the growing Southern market with an annual capacity of approximately 9 million+ sqm of Glazed Vitrified Tiles.
capex_expansion.quote: To cater to the growing Southern market, the Company has announced a new manufacturing facility with an annual capacity of approximately 9 million+ sqm. of Glazed Vitrified Tiles.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested INR30 crores in the Somany Max plant to improve utilization levels.
capex_expansion.quote: We put in an investment of INR30 crores to make the utilization level better in Somany Max by putting the press.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins increased by 3.6% to 11.6% for the quarter due to operational efficiencies and capacity utilization.
margins_costs.quote: As a result of capacity utilization, our EBITDA margins have gone up on operational efficiencies, both on capacity utilization in our plants and also on the JV performances. So EBITDA margins go up by 3.6% to 11.6% for the quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Natural gas price increases have been between 16% and 18%, and the company passed on all gas price increases.
margins_costs.quote: Every month, there have been a small increases in gas price. Fortunately, we've been able to pass on all the gas price increase until now. So the current price increase has been between 16% and 18%.

margins_costs.claim: Blended natural gas price comes in at about INR68 for the North, while South and Morbi are in the mid-70s.
margins_costs.quote: Yes. So our blended price comes in at about INR68. And South, we're still buying partly in spot. So South is -- South and Morbi are pretty much at the same level, which is close to mid-70s. And in the North, it is slightly lower, which is around the INR68, INR69 level.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margin improved to 11.6% driven by product mix improvement and continued focus on operational efficiencies.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin improved to 11.6%, driven by product mix improvement and continued focus on operational efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA improved to 11.4% in Q4 and 9.3% for the entire year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the year is 9.3% and for the quarter was 11.4%.

margins_costs.claim: Gas pricing for Morbi in May is around INR74 plus 6% tax.
margins_costs.quote: So, the Morbi pricing is currently -- for May, the pricing is INR74 plus 6% ballpark.

margins_costs.claim: Total cost increase from gas and other input costs is estimated at approximately INR6.5 to INR7 per square foot.
margins_costs.quote: So total increase of approximately INR7 a square foot is what we see. So depending on the plant, depending on the value addition, anywhere between INR6.5 to INR7 is the price increase in current scenario.

orders_capacity.quote: Morbi operations have completely started. They have resumed 100% production on very expensive gas

orders_capacity.claim: Overall capacity utilization was largely flat, moving from approximately 80% to 79% for the year.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization was largely flat from approximately 80% to 79%. So that is largely flat.

orders_capacity.claim: The Somany Max plant almost achieved a breakeven compared to a loss of INR9 crores in the corresponding quarter last year.
orders_capacity.quote: Max plant did -- there's good news there that we almost did a breakeven at Max plant. Corresponding quarter last year, same quarter of Q4, the loss was about INR9 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital days came down from 17 to 12 days.
capital_allocation.quote: Working capital days also have come down from 17 to 12 days.

capital_allocation.claim: Total capex outlay from now to FY27 end is looked at approximately INR275 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So from now to '27 end, we have already looked at approximately INR275 crores outlay, which includes the INR220 crores plant plus balancing equipment in various other plants and some more balancing equipment in the Bathware, sanitaryware plant.

capital_allocation.claim: About 65% to 70% of the capex will be funded through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: and we will be funding about 65%, 70% of this through internal accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: The company cannot do a share buyback for the next 6 to 8 months due to an embargo from SEBI while consolidating wholly owned subsidiaries.
capital_allocation.quote: Unfortunately, we are consolidating some of our JV -- sorry, our wholly owned subs, and therefore, there is an embargo on -- from SEBI. We can't do a share buyback for the next 6, 8 months.

risks_headwinds.claim: Gas prices have been extremely volatile with small increases every month.
risks_headwinds.quote: The gas price has been extremely volatile. I had mentioned that in the earnings call for the FY26, but the gas price since then has been extremely volatile. Every month, there have been a small increases in gas price.

risks_headwinds.claim: Exports are down due to geopolitical reasons.
risks_headwinds.quote: The only negative in the quarter has been from a Morbi perspective is exports has been down due to geopolitical reasons, the export is down a good 50%, 60% from the peak.

risks_headwinds.claim: The quarter witnessed supply-side disruptions in the Morbi cluster due to fuel shortages, labour unavailability, and elevated gas prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: The quarter witnessed supply-side disruptions in the Morbi cluster due to fuel shortages, labour unavailability, and elevated gas prices, resulting in production curtailments across the industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Gas prices increased very significantly following geopolitical events in March.
risks_headwinds.quote: Gas price, as you all know, has increased very significantly, which we can talk about that. I'm sure there'll be a lot of question-answers around that.

risks_headwinds.claim: Morbi faces a major labor shortage, with approximately 60% to 65% of Morbi up and running.
risks_headwinds.quote: The situation currently in Morbi is that whoever has started up is facing a little bit of challenge with labor. There a major, major, major labor shortage in Morbi. As a result of that, as we speak today, approximately 60%, 65% of Morbi is up and running.

management_commitments.claim: The newly announced 9 million square meter plant in the South will be up and ready in the next 12 to 15 months.
management_commitments.quote: Because of that, we have announced setting up a 9 million square meter plant -- 9-plus million square meter plant in the South, which would be up and ready by in the next 12 to 15 months.

management_commitments.claim: The 9 million square meter plant in the South will be operational by the end of quarter 3 or beginning of quarter 4 of next year.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, end of quarter 3, beginning quarter 4 of next year, it will be operational.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company's focus will remain on delivering profitable growth through market share gains, product premiumization, higher capacity utilization, disciplined cost management, and stronger cash flow generation.
management_commitments.quote: Our focus will remain on delivering profitable growth through market share gains, product premiumization, higher capacity utilization, disciplined cost management, and stronger cash flow generation.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company will continue to leverage its strong brand equity and extensive distribution network to capitalize on emerging market opportunities.
management_commitments.quote: We will continue to leverage our strong brand equity and extensive distribution network to capitalize on emerging market opportunities.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets to improve EBITDA margin by at least 1.5% or more from the current base.
management_commitments.quote: our guidance is to improve EBITDA margin from here by at least 1.5% or more.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects volume growth in the tile business to be in very decent single digits for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: '27 number, we should be able to get a decent single-digit growth in terms of volume.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets a very aggressive double-digit growth for the sanitaryware business.
management_commitments.quote: And this year, we've taken a very aggressive target, a very aggressive double-digit target.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
